record.one_liner: Harvest provides a REST API v2 for tracking time, managing projects, invoices, and expenses, supporting OAuth2 and Personal Access Tokens.

auth_methods.quote: Harvest requires applications to authenticate all requests with OAuth2 or Personal Access Tokens .

api_type.quote: The Harvest V2 API is a REST API that allows you to interact with your Harvest account programmatically.
